OPENCTI_URL.description: The base URL of the OpenCTI instance.

OPENCTI_TOKEN.description: The API token to connect to OpenCTI.

CONNECTOR_LOG_LEVEL.description: The minimum level of logs to display.

CONNECTOR_DURATION_PERIOD.description: The period of time to await between two runs of the connector.

ACCENTURE_ACTI_USERNAME.description: The username of the Accenture ACTI account used to authenticate.

ACCENTURE_ACTI_PASSWORD.description: The password of the Accenture ACTI account used to authenticate.

ACCENTURE_ACTI_USER_POOL_ID.description: The AWS Cognito user pool ID provided by Accenture ACTI.

ACCENTURE_ACTI_CLIENT_ID.description: The AWS Cognito client ID provided by Accenture ACTI.

ACCENTURE_ACTI_S3_BUCKET_NAME.description: The name of the Accenture ACTI S3 bucket to collect data from.

ACCENTURE_ACTI_S3_BUCKET_REGION.description: The AWS region of the Accenture ACTI S3 bucket.

ACCENTURE_ACTI_S3_BUCKET_ACCESS_KEY.description: The AWS access key used to read the Accenture ACTI S3 bucket.

ACCENTURE_ACTI_S3_BUCKET_SECRET_KEY.description: The AWS secret key used to read the Accenture ACTI S3 bucket.

ACCENTURE_ACTI_TLP_LEVEL.description: The TLP marking applied to the imported data.

ACCENTURE_ACTI_RELATIVE_IMPORT_START_DAT.description: The relative period of time to look back for the first import.

ACCENTURE_ACTI_THREAT_ACTOR_AS_INTRUSION.description: Whether to convert imported threat actors into intrusion sets.
